how_desc: Setup takes a few minutes. After that, Hontrio works on the campaign every day, and you can see every change it makes.
how_connect_desc: Connect your store platform, your Google Ads account and Merchant Center. Hontrio only reads your products and orders and never changes anything in your store.

how_launch_img: The store's products drop one by one into a Shopping campaign, with a budget of 40 RON a day
how_pilot_desc: It removes the products and searches that cost money without bringing sales, on its own or after you approve. If a campaign loses money, it pauses it, and it only raises the budget with your approval.

gdata_desc: To create and manage your store's campaigns, Hontrio asks for access to Google Ads and Google Merchant Center. You grant this access in Google's own window, and you can take it back at any time.
gdata_ads: Hontrio sees the ad accounts you have access to, so you can pick your store's account. In that account, it reads your campaigns, their results and your order tracking, known as conversions. It creates your store's Shopping campaigns and doesn't change other campaigns without your permission. It changes the budget only with your approval.
gdata_merchant: Hontrio reads your products in Merchant Center, along with their status and the issues Google found, so it knows which products can go into campaigns. It also reads Google's reports on prices and best-selling products. For large catalogs, it can add a label to products left out of a campaign, in a separate data source called “Hontrio”. The data your store sends stays unchanged.
gdata_never_1: It doesn't sell your data or use it for advertising, ours or anyone else's.
gdata_never_2: It doesn't share your data with other companies, except the providers Hontrio needs in order to run, such as hosting and the database.
gdata_never_3: It doesn't use your data to train artificial intelligence models.
gdata_never_4: It doesn't create or edit images and doesn't generate content with artificial intelligence.
gdata_limited: Hontrio's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
gdata_disconnect: You can disconnect your Google account at any time from Settings. Hontrio then revokes the access Google gave it and deletes the connection. You can also remove the access directly from your Google Account.

faq_desc: Answers to the questions store owners ask us most often.
faq_contact: Got another question? Write to us at
faq_q1: What do I need to get started?
faq_a1: You need an online store, a Google Ads account, your products in Google Merchant Center and order tracking in Google Ads, known as conversions. Hontrio checks all of this before your first campaign and tells you what's missing. The Google accounts are free. You only pay for the ads.
faq_q2: Which store platforms does it work with?
faq_a2: Edinio, WooCommerce, Shopify, Gomag, MerchantPro and OpenCart. Connecting takes a few minutes. Hontrio only reads data from your store and never changes your products, prices or orders.
faq_q3: Do I need to know Google Ads?
faq_a3: No. Hontrio builds the campaign the way Google recommends and manages it every day. You only set the budget, and the Reports section shows you what sales the ads bring in.
faq_q4: What kind of campaigns does Hontrio create?
faq_a4: Google Shopping campaigns, meaning the ads that show the product's photo, price and name. The first one is a Standard Shopping campaign. Once the account reaches 15 sales in 30 days, the autopilot moves to Performance Max, still with only your store's products. You can also create separate campaigns for a category, a brand or products you pick.
faq_q5: What does Hontrio change in my Google Ads account?
faq_a5: Hontrio only changes the campaigns it created, meaning their products, the excluded searches and the budget. It changes the budget only with your approval. It checks the campaigns you already have before launch, so they don't compete for the same products, but it doesn't change them unless you let it.
faq_q6: Can I control what the autopilot does?
faq_a6: Yes. You can choose between two modes. In “With approval” mode, the autopilot suggests changes and you decide. In “Automatic” mode, it applies them on its own. In both modes, the budget only goes up with your approval. Without asking, the autopilot only keeps the product list up to date and pauses a campaign that costs more than it brings in, in which case you get a notification and an email. Every change shows up in the log.
faq_q7: How much ad budget do I need?
faq_a7: You choose the budget and pay Google for it directly. As a starting point, Hontrio suggests a daily amount. If you already run Shopping campaigns, it starts from what you spend now. If not, it suggests a fifth of your average order value, for example €10 a day for a €50 average order.
faq_a8: During the launch period, Hontrio is free. After that, what you pay depends on the sales Hontrio brings you in a month. Up to €1,000 you pay nothing, up to €2,000 you pay €39, and above that you pay 2% of sales. Stores that sell in lei have their own grid. There is no subscription and no minimum term.
faq_q9: How do you know which sales Hontrio brought?
faq_a9: Every Hontrio ad carries a tag in its address that shows the visitor came from Hontrio. Your store saves the tag on the order, and Hontrio reads it from there. Only orders whose last click came from a Hontrio campaign count, and you can see the list in your account. Gomag doesn’t pass on the order’s tag, so for Gomag stores we count the conversions Google Ads reports for Hontrio campaigns, without the share of shipping, VAT and cancelled orders.
faq_a10: From your store, it reads products, prices, stock and orders, along with their source. From Google, it reads campaigns, their results and the products' status in Merchant Center. We don't keep the buyer's name, email, phone number or address from orders, and we never sell data.
